title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #17

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many millilitres are in 1 litre? (1 mark)
   A. 1000
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 10 000

2. What does the large intestine do with the leftovers? (1 mark)
   A. Swallows them
   B. Chews them
   C. Turns them into saliva
   D. Takes back water and forms faeces

3. Why are gumboots useful when handling waste? (1 mark)
   A. They protect the feet from sharp things and dirt
   B. They make waste lighter
   C. They make waste rot
   D. They make hands clean

4. Why is polythene dangerous for goats and cows? (1 mark)
   A. They may eat it and get sick
   B. It makes them grow
   C. It makes them sweet
   D. It makes milk

5. Which of these is an artificial source of light? (1 mark)
   A. The sun
   B. Lightning
   C. Electric bulb
   D. Stars

6. Why is a thermometer better than touching to find how hot something is? (1 mark)
   A. It is noisy
   B. It is heavy
   C. It is dangerous
   D. It is safe and gives a number

7. What are the two main types of things carried by the stem? (1 mark)
   A. Sound and light
   B. Heat and cold
   C. Air and stones
   D. Water and food

8. In the mouth, which part helps to move food around and swallow? (1 mark)
   A. Gullet
   B. Stomach
   C. Rectum
   D. Tongue

9. Which of these is a result of wasting water? (1 mark)
   A. Less money spent
   B. More rain
   C. More trees
   D. Less water for others

10. Which part of the plant takes in water from the soil? (1 mark)
   A. Flower
   B. Seed coat
   C. Stem
   D. Roots

11. Where should a water conservation poster be put? (1 mark)
   A. Under a bed
   B. In a bin
   C. In a cupboard
   D. Near a tap or the school gate

12. What does a green traffic light tell a driver? (1 mark)
   A. Go
   B. Stop at once
   C. Stop
   D. Sleep

13. At what temperature does water boil? (1 mark)
   A. 50 degrees Celsius
   B. 0 degrees Celsius
   C. 10 degrees Celsius
   D. 100 degrees Celsius

14. Which artificial light uses energy from the sun? (1 mark)
   A. Solar lamp
   B. Candle
   C. Firewood
   D. Paraffin lamp

15. Why should you not pull leaves off a young plant for fun? (1 mark)
   A. The leaves make the roots sweet
   B. Leaves are heavy
   C. The plant needs its leaves to make food
   D. The plant has too many leaves

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Draw a simple diagram of the digestive system and label mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, large intestine and anus. (5 marks)

17. Describe the characteristics that show that animals are living things. Use examples. (5 marks)

18. Give two natural and two artificial sources of light. (2 marks)

19. Explain why a mirror or a shiny cup is not a source of light. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 1000
   1 litre is 1000 ml.

2. D — Takes back water and forms faeces
   Water is absorbed and the rest becomes solid waste.

3. A — They protect the feet from sharp things and dirt
   Boots protect feet from cuts and germs.

4. A — They may eat it and get sick
   Animals that eat polythene can become ill or die.

5. C — Electric bulb
   Bulbs are made by people.

6. D — It is safe and gives a number
   A thermometer avoids burns and measures.

7. D — Water and food
   The stem carries water and mineral salts up and food made in leaves to other parts.

8. D — Tongue
   The tongue moves food and helps swallowing.

9. D — Less water for others
   Wasted water is not available to others.

10. D — Roots
   Roots take in water and mineral salts.

11. D — Near a tap or the school gate
   Posters should be seen by many people.

12. A — Go
   Green means go.

13. D — 100 degrees Celsius
   Pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

14. A — Solar lamp
   A solar lamp charges by day.

15. C — The plant needs its leaves to make food
   Leaves are the food factories of the plant.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: A neat tube drawn from mouth to anus with each part labelled in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the drawing and 1 mark for each of four correct labels.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Animals feed, grow, breathe, reproduce, remove waste, move, respond and die. Give examples such as a goat eating grass and a hen laying eggs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sign to a maximum of 5.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Natural: sun, stars, lightning, firefly. Artificial: bulb, torch, candle, lantern, solar lamp.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct natural and 1 mark for two correct artificial.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It does not make its own light. It only reflects light that falls on it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not making light, 1 mark for reflecting, 1 mark for explanation.
